capabilities: Turn canvas text nodes into title-only cards with hidden Markdown bodies
Open and edit card bodies in a popup with Obsidian's Markdown renderer
Search card titles and hidden bodies across all canvases
Export a card to a Markdown note with source frontmatter
Show the first image embed in a body as a card cover thumbnail
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition plugin; 'cards' here are canvas text nodes whose Markdown body is hidden behind a clickable title.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly); mobile is not supported. Card data is stored in a custom node field inside .canvas files, so cards survive opening the vault without the plugin. Uses some undocumented Canvas internals (not public API). Additional docs live in docs/ (DESIGN.md, VERIFICATION.md).
problem: Canvas text nodes display their full text on the board, and bodies stored outside node titles are invisible to Obsidian's global search, which only indexes node titles.

relations.evidence: Tested with Obsidian 1.14.4 on Windows and with Advanced Canvas 7.1.0 enabled (cards, dragging, context menus and Advanced Canvas features coexist).

summary: Canvas extension that turns text nodes into cards showing only a clickable title, with the full Markdown body hidden until opened in a popup.
